mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 3.0%, it signals emergency monetary intervention in response to economic deterioration, triggering a short-term equity rebound as liquidity conditions improve within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in nonfarm payrolls signal accelerating labor market deterioration, which precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery regimes characterized by rising new housing starts, consumer confidence and construction activity support broader economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during housing market recovery periods, or Rank IC for HOUST falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the unemployment rate over 3 months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has trended upward over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers equity sell-offs as economic growth prospects weaken within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and low federal funds rates (below 3.0%) indicate stagflationary pressures from weak supply coupled with accommodative policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction regimes marked by declining industrial production, manufacturing weakness signals broader economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during industrial contraction, or Rank IC for INDPRO falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
